name: trait-S02-span-a
refs: Our signed young S02, Untuva (project-owned): the creature, exactly. Its body is bare (no markings) and its cap is the 'between' span.
prompt: Paint THREE panels side by side, equal size, a small gap between them, on plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no borders, no text. All three show the SAME whole creature as the reference (the round warm chestnut puffball body, eyes, peach blush, the ochre-tan cap, same pose, same brush and soft painterly light from the top left), the whole creature large in each panel with clear magenta around it. Only the width of the cap changes; the body never changes. LEFT, 'small cap': a small cap that only covers the crown of the head, narrower than the body. MIDDLE, 'between': exactly the reference's cap. RIGHT, 'wide cap': a wide cap whose brim reaches well past both sides of the body, like a parasol. Same cap colour and texture in all three. Body, face, pose, size and light identical. No props, no ground, no shadow, no glow.
